files.content:
name: review
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - name: Review
      run: bash "$GITHUB_ACTION_PATH/scripts/run_review.sh"

_CI_GATE_ENV_KEYS=(
  PATH HOME
  GH_TOKEN REPO PR_NUMBER
  CI_STATUS_CHECK CI_TIMEOUT_SEC CI_CHECKS_FILE
)

wait_for_ci_command() {
  local -a env_args=()
  local key
  for key in "${_CI_GATE_ENV_KEYS[@]}"; do
    if [ -n "${!key+x}" ]; then
      env_args+=("${key}=${!key}")
    fi
  done
  env -i "${env_args[@]}" bash "$SCRIPT_DIR/wait_for_ci.sh"
}
Self-hosted runners behind a proxy set HTTP_PROXY and SSL_CERT_FILE; gh reads GH_CONFIG_DIR.
